mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate above 0.5 percentage points from the prior month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC for UNRATE rise >0.5pp is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in both consumer spending (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate a broad-based weakening in aggregate demand, which triggers a sell-off in equities as corporate revenue growth expectations decline, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both RSAFS and HOUST decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of manufacturing supply chain disruption (indicated by a decline in industrial production below its 12-month moving average), corporate production costs rise and output constraints emerge, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 12-month MA, or the Rank IC for the condition is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the consumer price index (CPI) above 0.3 percentage points from the prior month signals accelerating inflation, which prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC for CPI rise >0.3pp is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in both non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicate a labor market that is simultaneously contracting in employment and becoming tighter, which signals an economic slowdown that triggers a short-term sell-off in equities, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both PAYEMS and UNRATE decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% year-over-year), a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%) signals aggressive monetary tightening, which reduces corporate profit margins and equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY and FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or the Rank IC for the joint condition is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) relative to its 6-month moving average indicates weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces corporate output and profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 6-month MA, or the Rank IC for INDPRO decline is below 0.03.
